remarks: Beautifully updated 1BR apartment in the heart of downtown Stamford. Located in the Biltmore, this apartment boasts an open-concept living space, oversized windows and high ceilings that create a spacious and airy atmosphere. The well-appointed kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, making meal preparation a breeze. The spacious bedroom features a large walk-in closet, oversized windows, and hardwood floors. The bathroom is sleek and modern, with elegant fixtures and a luxurious bathtub/shower combo and is accessible from bedroom and living room. Unit is located on the plaza level just steps away from fitness center, community room, laundry room, storage and outdoor courtyard. This apartment also includes central air conditioning, and heating. The Biltmore offers 24-7 hour concierge service, state of the art 2000 sq.ft. fitness center, shuttle service, large outdoor courtyard, community room, and secure on-site parking. This apartment is just steps away from popular restaurants, cafes, and boutiques, as well as public transportation options for easy commuting. Don't miss your chance to experience stylish urban living at its finest - schedule a tour today! Apartment will be freshly painted before commencement of lease.
